description_target.target_text: Use the blue(1) anchor as a template, but only in terms of row counts. A candidate matches even if its rows are shifted left or right inside its own box, as long as the sequence of row occupancies is identical. Find that candidate and output its cropped silhouette recolored to cyan(8).

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))

    (define (cell< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (top-left< a b)
      (if (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
          (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))
          (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))))
    (define (row-profile obj)
      (for/list ([r (in-range (obj-r1 obj) (+ (obj-r2 obj) 1))])
        (count-where (lambda (p) (= (first p) r)) (obj-cells obj))))
    (define (col-profile obj)
      (for/list ([c (in-range (obj-c1 obj) (+ (obj-c2 obj) 1))])
        (count-where (lambda (p) (= (second p) c)) (obj-cells obj))))
    (define (max-row-peak obj) (apply max (row-profile obj)))
    (define (max-col-peak obj) (apply max (col-profile obj)))
    (define (constant-row-profile obj)
      (let ((rp (row-profile obj)))
        (all? (lambda (x) (= x (first rp))) rp)))
    (define (crop-component obj [color 8])
      (let ((cells (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (obj-r1 obj)) (- (second p) (obj-c1 obj))))
                        (obj-cells obj))))
        (paint-cells (empty-grid (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj) 0) cells color)))
    (define (row-span-cells obj)
      (remove-duplicates
       (flatmap (lambda (r)
                  (let ((cols (map second (filter (lambda (p) (= (first p) r)) (obj-cells obj)))))
                    (if (empty? cols)
                        (list)
                        (for/list ([c (in-range (apply min cols) (+ (apply max cols) 1))]) (list r c)))))
                (range (obj-r1 obj) (+ (obj-r2 obj) 1)))))
    (define (col-span-cells obj)
      (remove-duplicates
       (flatmap (lambda (c)
                  (let ((rs (map first (filter (lambda (p) (= (second p) c)) (obj-cells obj)))))
                    (if (empty? rs)
                        (list)
                        (for/list ([r (in-range (apply min rs) (+ (apply max rs) 1))]) (list r c)))))
                (range (obj-c1 obj) (+ (obj-c2 obj) 1)))))
    (define (row-fill grid banned)
      (for/fold ([out grid]) ([obj (in-list (objects grid 0))])
        (if (member (obj-color obj) banned) out (paint-cells out (row-span-cells obj) (obj-color obj)))))
    (define (col-fill grid banned)
      (for/fold ([out grid]) ([obj (in-list (objects grid 0))])
        (if (member (obj-color obj) banned) out (paint-cells out (col-span-cells obj) (obj-color obj)))))
    (define (row-histogram profile [color 8])
      (let ((w (if (empty? profile) 1 (max 1 (apply max profile)))))
        (grid-from-fn (length profile) w
          (lambda (r c) (if (< c (list-ref profile r)) color 0)))))
    (define (col-histogram profile [color 8])
      (let ((h (if (empty? profile) 1 (max 1 (apply max profile)))))
        (grid-from-fn h (length profile)
          (lambda (r c) (if (< r (list-ref profile c)) color 0)))))
    (define (canonical-intersection rows-profile cols-profile [color 8])
      (grid-from-fn (length rows-profile) (length cols-profile)
        (lambda (r c)
          (if (and (< c (list-ref rows-profile r)) (< r (list-ref cols-profile c))) color 0))))
    (define (split-vertical-panels grid sep-color)
      (define sep-cols
        (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c) sep-color)) (range 0 (rows grid))))
                (range 0 (cols grid))))
      (define bounds (append (list -1) sep-cols (list (cols grid))))
      (let loop ([xs bounds])
        (if (empty? (rest xs))
            (list)
            (let* ((left (+ (first xs) 1))
                   (right (- (second xs) 1))
                   (tail (loop (rest xs))))
              (if (<= left right)
                  (cons (subgrid grid 0 left (- (rows grid) 1) right) tail)
                  tail)))))
    (define (single-largest grid [banned (list)])
      (first
       (sort (filter (lambda (obj) (not (member (obj-color obj) banned))) (objects grid 0))
             (lambda (a b)
               (cond [(not (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))]
                     [(not (= (max-row-peak a) (max-row-peak b))) (> (max-row-peak a) (max-row-peak b))]
                     [(not (= (max-col-peak a) (max-col-peak b))) (> (max-col-peak a) (max-col-peak b))]
                     [else (top-left< a b)])))))
    (define (detect-marker grid color)
      (let* ((objs (sort (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) color)) (objects grid 0)) top-left<))
             (cells (sort (obj-cells (first objs)) cell<)))
        (first cells)))
    (define (pad-to xs len)
      (append xs (make-list (max 0 (- len (length xs))) 0)))

    (define comps (objects g 0))
    (define anchor (first (sort (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 1)) comps) top-left<)))
    (define target
      (first (filter (lambda (obj) (equal? (row-profile obj) (row-profile anchor)))
                     (sort (filter (lambda (obj) (not (= (obj-color obj) 1))) comps) top-left<))))
    (crop-component target 8)
  ))
